functions.spark_sql:
SELECT id, STACK(3, i, CAST(NULL AS BIGINT))
FROM bench WHERE id < 8

SELECT id,
    STACK(2, i, CAST(p AS BIGINT), CAST(NULL AS BIGINT), CAST(4 AS BIGINT)) AS (x, y)
FROM bench WHERE id < 8

SELECT id, value FROM bench
LATERAL VIEW STACK(1, i) expanded AS value
WHERE id < 8

SELECT id,
    STACK(2, i, CAST(CASE WHEN id = 5 THEN 'bad' ELSE '7' END AS BIGINT)) AS value
FROM bench WHERE id < 8
